home.title: Product definition required
home.description: The desktop application foundation is ready. No business capabilities are assumed until the product goal, scope, and success criteria are defined.
home.next_step_description: Define the product purpose, first core workflow, and verifiable success criteria.
home.workspace_description: Product capabilities will begin here after the scope is confirmed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage local interface preferences and enabled system capabilities.
settings.application_description: The application name and version come from the current package.
settings.language_description: A saved choice takes priority over the system language and updates native menus.
settings.language_error: The native interface language could not be synchronized. Check the app state and try again.
settings.theme_description: Choose light, dark, or follow system. The preference is stored only on this device.
settings.release_notes_description: View the local release notes bundled with a formal candidate.
settings.system_notification_description: The app may send native notifications only after you explicitly enable them here.
settings.system_notification_error: The notification setting could not be updated. The switch was restored to the readable system state. Check system notification permission and try again.
settings.system_notification_unknown: Notification permission and the local preference are both unavailable. Reload after the system becomes reachable.
settings.autostart_description: Launch and show the app normally after sign-in. The operating system login item is authoritative.
settings.autostart_error: The login item could not be updated. The switch was restored to the readable system state. Check system login items and try again.
settings.autostart_unknown: The operating system login item cannot be read right now. Reload it later.

release_notes.loading: Reading release notes bundled with this candidate
release_notes.load_failed: Release notes are not generated before the first formal release. If this is a formal candidate, reinstall the complete candidate or retry.

workbench.title: Local Hook relay
workbench.description: Listens for AgentHooks events on 127.0.0.1. It does not scan the LAN.

management.title: Monitor management
management.description: Configure display slots, behavior images, and optional text for enabled agents.
management.noClient: No agent is enabled. Select the clients you want to manage under Hooks settings.
management.behaviorDescription: Choose a local image for each behavior; display text is optional.
management.noImages: No images are available yet. You can upload one directly from this picker and continue configuring.
management.stateDescription: Shown while the agent is in this state
management.ready: All states are configured and ready to save.

slot.title: Display position
slot.description: Click the matching cell to choose a display position

images.title: Local images
images.description: Images stay in this app's data directory and are not sent to LAN devices.
images.emptyDescription: Select multiple JPEG, PNG, or GIF images at once, then assign them to agents.

settings.title: Hooks settings
settings.description: Choose which agents should receive Hooks and write the local Hook configs. This is not the app Settings page.
settings.managementDescription: Review local config locations and write Hooks for each enabled agent.
settings.chooseAgentFirst: Enable at least one agent in the card above.

desktop.title: Monitor settings
desktop.description: Open or close the desktop pet overlay and choose whether the bunny ear close control is shown. This is not Hooks settings and not the app Settings page.
desktop.petDescription: Turn on to show the desktop pet overlay; turn off to hide it. The main window stays visible.
desktop.earDescription: Turn on to show the circular close control on the overlay; turn off to hide it.

pet.openAria: Open the desktop pet floating overlay
pet.settingsDescription: Drag with the left button. Right-click opens this settings window. This is not the app Settings page.

outcome.restartRequired: Restart or start a new session

errors.metadata_description: Restart the app. If the problem continues, verify that the installation is complete.
errors.not_found_description: This address is not part of the current application.

monitor.imageUnsupportedType: This image type is not supported. Use JPEG, PNG, or GIF.
monitor.imageNotFound: That local image was not found.
monitor.slotOutOfRange: Display position must be between {{min}} and {{max}}.
monitor.behaviorsIncomplete: Each of the four behaviors must be configured once.
monitor.behaviorDuplicate: The same behavior cannot be configured twice.
monitor.unknownImage: The selected image is not in the local library.
